subject: [hw] R1: e1950e9f is not LDREXD; the valid A32 LDREXD/STREXD work in V12 (e1b52f9f / e1a50f92)
body:
I checked your e1950e9f report: llvm-objdump decodes 0xe1950e9f as <unknown>, not LDREXD. The valid A32 encodings are:
  ldrexd r2,r3,[r5]     = e1b52f9f   (cond 0001 1011 Rn Rt 1111 1001 Rt2)
  strexd r0,r2,r3,[r5]  = e1a50f92
I called V12s n2a32_arm_mem directly:
  e1b52f9f -> rc=0 r2=11111111 r3=22222222 excl_valid=8
  e1a50f92 -> rc=0 r0=0 (success), memory updated
So V12 does not have a missing A32 LDREXD/STREXD; the stop you and T01 see must be a different encoding (probably the T32 LDREXD/STREXD form or a mis-extracted word). Please send the actual stop_insn from diffrun/asmrun for k_v16_atomic; if it is the T32 form, V16s dual_excl should be checked (hi4=7, l=1 for LDREXD and l=0 for STREXD). I did not change my V12 verdict.
